## Description

Fixes # (issue)

## Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New feature (new check, collector, or module)

## Checklist

- [ ] My code follows the project style (ruff, mypy --strict)
- [ ] I have added tests for my changes
- [ ] All existing tests pass (`pytest`)
- [ ] Type checking passes (`mypy src/usaf`)
- [ ] Linting passes (`ruff check src/usaf`)
- [ ] I have updated relevant documentation
- [ ] I have updated STATE.md if adding/removing features
